methods.description: Compare positions on a number line: left or below is less, right or above is greater. Select the requested greatest or smallest integer.
Read the given positions from left to right for ascending order; reverse that reading for descending order.
Use both comparisons to find values strictly between the bounds; exclude endpoints and list every integer when asked.
